title: lespedeza sieboldii var. albiflora
intro: Lespedeza sieboldii var. albiflora, commonly known as White Japanese Clover, is a flowering plant in the legume family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal disorders due to its estrogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of White Japanese Clover are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory activities. The bioactive constituents in this plant have been shown to exhibit significant pharmacological effects, including cardiovascular protection, immune system modulation, and anti-cancer activities.
